name: Celebrity Problem
statement:
1. You are given a number n, representing the number of people in a party.
2. You are given n strings of n length containing 0's and 1's
3. If there is a '1' in ith row, jth spot, then person i knows about person j.
4. A celebrity is defined as somebody who knows no other person than himself but everybody else knows him.
5. If there is a celebrity print it's index otherwise print "none".

Note -> There can be only one celebrity. Think why?
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^4
e1, e2, .. n * n elements belongs to the set (0, 1)

editorial:
We will be using elimination approach.

We will be using a stack containing index of person and then we will pop two elements out of it. We will check which one knows the other and the index who does not know the other will be pushed back into the stack. We will repeat these steps until our stack contains only one index.

Let us take another example to understand this question.

We have a stack containing the index of the person.

We will pop from it

Now we will check whether 2 know 3 or not. In the above matrix we can see that the cell 23 contains 0 which implies that 2 do not know 3. That means that 3 is not the celebrity. So we will push 2 into the stack and will leave 3 out.

Here we will pop again and check whether 1 knows 2 or not. We can clearly see that cell 12 contains 1 which implies that 1 know 2. Therefore 1 is not the celebrity so we will push 2 into the stack and keep 1 out of it.

Our stack is not empty yet so we will pop again and check whether 0 knows 2 or not. Since cell 02 contains 1 so 0 knows 2 which means that 0 is not the celebrity. So 0 will remain out of the stack and we will push 2 back into the stack.

We are left with 2 in the stack only but this does not tell us that 2 is a celebrity. In the above example we just eliminated those indexes which were not celebrity like 3, 1 and 0 i.e. we only checked for three cells 23, 12 and 02 for respective indexes. Here 2 is just potentially a celebrity, it is not a celebrity with certainty. So for that we have to check row2 and column2 except for cell 22.

Which means 2 does not know anybody but everybody should know him.

LOGIC-

->Pop

->Elimination

->Push

->Finally check for the last element whether it is celebrity or not.
